description: Change fields of a Dynamics 365 lead (logical names, e.g. {"telephone1":"+49 …","leadqualitycode":1}). Reads the lead first and sends If-Match with its etag, so a change made in Dynamics meanwhile is not overwritten; reports fields Dynamics did not store as sent. WRITES into the customer's Dynamics 365 — it goes through the permission gate and the Dynamics write log (audit_log dynamics_write).

fields.description: further Dataverse columns by logical name (lower case, e.g. {"address1_city":"Leipzig"}); lookups as {"parentaccountid@odata.bind":"/accounts(<GUID>)"}

lead_id.description: ID of the lead to change

name: update_dynamics_lead
